heading: How You Will Learn
sub: PTI's training model: 75% hands-on practice, 25% theory.
seo_title: How You Will Learn — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: How training works at Pioneer Technical Institute — hands-on workshop learning, production-unit practice, and examination pathways via UBTEB and DIT.
seo_keywords: PTI training model, hands-on vocational training Uganda, how you will learn Pioneer Technical Institute

sections.heading: Mostly Hands-On
sections.body: Every course at PTI runs on a 75% practical, 25% theory model. Rather than sitting through lectures about a trade, trainees spend most of their time in the workshop, kitchen, computer lab, or farm unit — doing the actual work under supervision.

sections.heading: Production-Unit Learning
sections.body: PTI's departments run production units that serve real paying customers — vehicles actually get repaired, garments actually get sewn, meals actually get served. This means trainees are tested on live jobs with real stakes, which builds confidence and a portfolio of real work before graduation.

sections.heading: Assessment & Certification
sections.body: Theory is assessed through UBTEB National Certificate examinations (for National Certificate courses) or DIT Trade Tests (for trade courses), alongside continuous practical assessment by instructors throughout the course.
